newsitem.title: USA: Blue Cross to acquire Colorado administrator.
newsitem.headline: Blue Cross to acquire Colorado administrator.

text.p: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Colorado said Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire National Benefit Administrators Inc from Acordia of Colorado Inc.
It said National Benefit will operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Its name and Colorado Springs headquarters will remain the same, it added.
"The acquisition of NBA is part of our overall strategy to increase market share in Colorado and surrounding states," it said in a statement.
Blue Cross said the deal is set to close by the end of August.
National Benefit provides third-party administration of health care services for employers, including school districts, municipalities, hospitals and manufacturers.
Blue Cross, which is privately-held, offers a variety of insurance including life and health.
